defmodule TokenAuth.Session do @moduledoc "Session management with email-based password reset" use GenServer require Logger defmodule State do defstruct sessions: %{}, reset_tokens: %{}, config: %{} end # Client API def start_link(opts) do GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__) end def request_password_reset(email) do GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:request_reset, email}) end def verify_reset_token(token) do GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:verify_token, token}) end # Server callbacks def init(opts) do config = %{ smtp_host: Keyword.get(opts, :smtp_host, "localhost"), smtp_port: Keyword.get(opts, :smtp_port, 25), from_address: Keyword.get(opts, :from_address, "noreply@example.com"), base_url: Keyword.get(opts, :base_url, "https://example.com") } {:ok, %State{config: config}} end def handle_call({:request_reset, email}, _from, state) do token = generate_token() expires = System.system_time(:second) + 3600 new_tokens = Map.put(state.reset_tokens, token, %{email: email, expires: expires}) new_state = %{state | reset_tokens: new_tokens} case send_reset_email(email, token, state.config) do :ok -> {:reply, {:ok, :sent}, new_state} {:error, reason} -> {:reply, {:error, reason}, new_state} end end def handle_call({:verify_token, token}, _from, state) do case Map.get(state.reset_tokens, token) do nil -> {:reply, {:error, :invalid_token}, state} %{expires: exp} when exp < System.system_time(:second) -> {:reply, {:error, :expired}, state} %{email: email} -> {:reply, {:ok, email}, state} end end # Email sending pipeline defp send_reset_email(recipient_email, token, config) do reset_url = "#{config.base_url}/reset?token=#{token}" subject = "Password Reset Request" body = build_body(reset_url) headers = build_email_headers( config.from_address, recipient_email, subject ) payload = headers <> "\r\n\r\n" <> body dispatch_via_smtp(payload, config) end defp build_email_headers(from, to, subject) do safe_from = sanitize_email_header(from) safe_to = sanitize_email_header(to) safe_subject = sanitize_email_header(subject) [ "From: #{safe_from}", "To: #{safe_to}", "Subject: #{safe_subject}", "MIME-Version: 1.0", "Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8", "Date: #{format_date()}" ] |> Enum.join("\r\n") end @doc """ Sanitizes header values by removing dangerous characters. First normalizes Unicode for consistent representation, then strips control characters including CR/LF. """ defp sanitize_email_header(value) when is_binary(value) do value |> normalize_unicode() |> strip_dangerous_chars() |> String.slice(0, 998) end defp sanitize_email_header(_), do: "" defp strip_dangerous_chars(input) do # Remove CR, LF, and other control characters input |> String.replace(~r/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/, "") end defp normalize_unicode(input) do # NFC normalization for consistent Unicode representation # This handles combining characters and compatibility equivalents :unicode.characters_to_nfc_binary(input) end defp build_body(reset_url) do """

You requested a password reset.

Click here to reset your password

This link expires in 1 hour.

""" end defp dispatch_via_smtp(payload, config) do case :gen_tcp.connect( String.to_charlist(config.smtp_host), config.smtp_port, [:binary, active: false] ) do {:ok, socket} -> :gen_tcp.send(socket, payload) :gen_tcp.close(socket) :ok {:error, reason} -> Logger.error("SMTP connection failed: #{inspect(reason)}") {:error, :smtp_failed} end end defp generate_token do :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false) end defp format_date do {{y, m, d}, {h, min, s}} = :calendar.universal_time() dow = case :calendar.day_of_the_week(y, m, d) do 1 -> "Mon"; 2 -> "Tue"; 3 -> "Wed"; 4 -> "Thu" 5 -> "Fri"; 6 -> "Sat"; 7 -> "Sun" end month = case m do 1 -> "Jan"; 2 -> "Feb"; 3 -> "Mar"; 4 -> "Apr" 5 -> "May"; 6 -> "Jun"; 7 -> "Jul"; 8 -> "Aug" 9 -> "Sep"; 10 -> "Oct"; 11 -> "Nov"; 12 -> "Dec" end "#{dow}, #{d} #{month} #{y} #{h}:#{min}:#{s} +0000" end end
